thread:
emma_finance: FYI spotted an ingestion gap for 2026-03-19 22:30-23:10 UTC. ledger shows missing partitions from collector cluster; estimated ~1.1M tokens. likely affects weekly invoices for a cohort of mid-size customers. assigning owners: @li_dev for hotfix, @maria_ops for backfill/coord. can we triage scope + decide invoice gating?

chuck_sre: looking. consumer lag on topic `usage-partitions-7` with offsets stuck. Cloud metrics show EBS I/O throttling on collector-3 for ~35m. therewas a noisy neighbor incident in the same AZ.

li_dev: thanks. reproducing locally shows sidecar consumer doesn't checkpoint when EBS latencies spike. PR to add checkpoint-on-receive + resilient commit in flight: https://git.internal/redwood/p/4312 (small). will push canary after CI.

maria_ops: containment proposal: 1) pause invoice rendering for tomorrow's run; 2) run bounded backfill consumer with `--parallel=4 --limit=10000` until offsets match; 3) generate provisional delta csv for finance; 4) if backfill completes < 4h, allow invoices with credits; else manual reissue.

emma_finance: pause invoices if backfill not done by 1765011400. prefer automated credits vs reissue where possible. need impacted account ids and token deltas.

billing-bot: scheduled job `invoice-render-2026-03-20` next run 2026-03-20T04:00:00Z. status: SCHEDULED.

ops-bot: alert: noisy-neighbor mitigation run on az-us-east1c at 2026-03-19T23:05:12Z. remediation: live-migrate noisy vm.

li_dev: canary deployed to prod in az-us-east-1c. command: `helm upgrade --reuse-values usage-sidecar --set az=us-east-1c`  watching checkpoint logs for `commit_success` events.

maria_ops: starting backfill now in dry-run mode (no writes) to validate idempotency. step: `python tools/backfill.py --topic usage-partitions-7 --from-offset 124582 --to-offset 124900 --dry-run --limit 5000`

emma_finance: copy. jonny from billing ops will need CSV with columns (account_id, window_start, window_end, delta_tokens, est_credit).

li_dev: canary reports: commits succeeding, latency down from 2.3s to 120ms. promoting fix to all collectors in affected AZ.

maria_ops: dry-run sample line: `acct_12b,2026-03-19T22:30Z,2026-03-19T22:45Z,478, $0.05`  uploading sample to s3://redwood-incident/1765009999/sample.csv

emma_finance: action list with owners + ETA: 
- Li (li_dev): rollout checkpoint fix to all affected collectors + confirm metrics (ETA: 1765010400).
- Maria (maria_ops): complete backfill run and produce delta CSV + upload (ETA: 1765011600).
- Emma (emma_finance): hold invoice queue if no confirmation by 1765011400; prepare credit policy note (ETA: 1765011400).
- Chuck (chuck_sre): run noisy neighbor audit & mitigation summary for postmortem (ETA: 1765014000).

billing-bot: invoice job paused per request from emma_finance. status: HELD.

maria_ops: backfill completed. total delayed tokens: 1,112,693 across 42 accounts. final report: s3://redwood-incident/1765009999/deltas.csv.

emma_finance: received. we'll compute credits and either issue credit memos or adjust invoices before customer send. thanks all. please add postmortem action items to the incident board and tag follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
